summary: Frontend-only validation of ABC Supply Catalog UI (browse/search/sync/add-to-inventory + generic Inventory regression) as owner pjacobsen@asgardsolution.io. All 12 UI requirements from the review request verified successfully; no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: AbcCatalog.jsx is clean and well-structured (~226 lines). Pricing is best-effort with try/catch, sync polls status with a bounded loop, and availability is rendered strictly as badges (never a numeric quantity) which satisfies the vendor-vs-on-hand separation requirement.
Minor: sync polling is fixed at 8 iterations x 1.5s = 12s; for large catalogs this could time out visually. Not a blocker for the mock (8 items).
Minor: pricing fetch is limited to first 50 priceable rows per page - fine for PAGE_SIZE=25 but hard-coded 50 is redundant.
seed_data_creation: Added MOCK-DRIP-EDGE-DIM to Inventory during test (matches expected flow). MOCK-SHINGLE-ARCH-WW and MOCK-ICEWATER-BARRIER were already added from prior runs and correctly show 'In Inventory' badges.
